description: Shared BPRUE specialization module catalog. Values are initial balancing targets. Weapon-class generators can opt into groups selectively instead of applying every group to every weapon.

lightweight_assembly.identity: Faster, lighter handling at the cost of recoil control.

recoil_control.identity: Prioritizes controllability during repeated fire over intrinsic precision.

precision_tuning.identity: Prioritizes shot precision at the cost of stronger recoil.

high_cyclic_system.identity: Aggressive cyclic rate with increased recoil and wear.

controlled_action.identity: Slower cycling in exchange for controllability and precision.

soft_target.identity: Experimental wounding profile: improves bleeding chance with reduced cover penetration; engine percentage semantics require in-game validation.

armor_piercing.identity: Penetrates cover more effectively at the expense of raw damage, without changing armor penetration.

hardened_components.identity: Longer service life at a small weight penalty.

lightweight_components.identity: Improved handling and weight at the cost of service life.

cqb_configuration.identity: Fast close-range handling and practical accuracy with reduced long-range performance.

range_configuration.identity: Long-range ballistic and precision tuning at the cost of slower handling.

sniper.range_configuration: Flatness +15%, damage drop-off length +10%, aiming speed -10%
sniper.cqb_configuration: Aiming speed +15%, dispersion +10%, flatness -10%, recoil recovery -10%
sniper.precision_tuning: Flatness +10%, damage drop-off length +10%, recoil control -8%

notes: Flatness is backed by vanilla EEffectType::EffectiveFireDistance effects (FlatnessUp5Effect through FlatnessUp30Effect).
Projectile velocity is independently backed by vanilla EEffectType::BulletSpeedSlowdown effects (ProjectileSpeedPos*Effect).
Armor penetration is backed by vanilla EEffectType::ArmorPiercing. Cover penetration is a separate vanilla EEffectType::CoverPiercing.
Negative/custom counterparts that do not already exist in vanilla must be emitted as BPRUE effects before generators consume this catalog.
SMG pistol-slot conversion remains an SMG-exclusive conversion group and is intentionally not represented as a generic specialization module.
